therapeutic_hypothesis.claimed_target: Retinoic acid receptor on MDSCs + CTLA-4
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: ATRA differentiates immature monocytes into mature dendritic cells while ipilimumab blocks CTLA-4 immune checkpoint
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Reduction of MDSC-mediated immunosuppression combined with T-cell activation

results.effect_size: MDSC frequency reduced from 34.35% to 7.29% with ATRA combination
results.target_engagement_evidence: MDSC frequency significantly reduced with ATRA combination (7.29% vs 34.35%)
biomarker_changes: MDSC frequency reduced with ATRA combination
Tumor-specific CD8+ T cell responses increased (14.28% vs 6.10% with ATRA)
